caption: One Enter at the end of a paragraph adds a blank line and starts the next paragraph.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['paragraph-enter']; p.settings.enabled = true; p.settings.lineBreakStyle = 'newline'; p.refreshStatus(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const s = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...s, state: { ...s.state, mode: 'source', source: false } }); const view = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; const e = view.editor; e.focus(); const content = view.containerEl.querySelector('.cm-content'); const key = (k, shift) => content.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, shiftKey: !!shift, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const at = e.getValue().indexOf("opens the next one."); if (at < 0) throw new Error('Missing text'); e.setCursor(e.offsetToPos(at + "opens the next one.".length)); key('Enter'); e.replaceSelection('The second paragraph starts here, after one key press.'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Enter in the middle of a paragraph splits it into two paragraphs.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['paragraph-enter']; p.settings.enabled = true; p.settings.lineBreakStyle = 'newline'; p.refreshStatus(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const s = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...s, state: { ...s.state, mode: 'source', source: true } }); const view = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; const e = view.editor; e.focus(); const content = view.containerEl.querySelector('.cm-content'); const key = (k, shift) => content.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, shiftKey: !!shift, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const at = e.getValue().indexOf("three days."); if (at < 0) throw new Error('Missing text'); e.setCursor(e.offsetToPos(at + "three days.".length)); key('Enter'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Shift+Enter with the HTML style adds a tag and a line break in the same paragraph.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['paragraph-enter']; p.settings.enabled = true; p.settings.lineBreakStyle = 'html'; p.refreshStatus(); const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const s = leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({ ...s, state: { ...s.state, mode: 'source', source: true } }); const view = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; const e = view.editor; e.focus(); const content = view.containerEl.querySelector('.cm-content'); const key = (k, shift) => content.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, shiftKey: !!shift, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); const at = e.getValue().indexOf("a visible tag."); if (at < 0) throw new Error('Missing text'); e.setCursor(e.offsetToPos(at + "a visible tag.".length)); key('Enter'); e.replaceSelection('Roses are red,'); key('Enter', true); e.replaceSelection('violets are blue.'); return 'ok'; })()
